style: 3D animation, original character design, dry slapstick, vivid saturated colors, high contrast
subject: ONE pompous old grey goose, long neck, huge wings, orange beak and feet, red-and-yellow striped paper party hat on his head
second_characters: ONE mole in a bright orange hard hat, calm, chewing sunflower seeds; stays on the pit rim
props: the mole's ONE shovel, wooden handle, steel blade; the goose's paper party hat and paper cone horn; ONE old black tire with green duckweed at the pit bottom
environment: a deep narrow pit in orange-red clay, twice the goose's height, at the edge of a green garden plot; roots in the walls; fresh earth heap on the rim; blue sky above
lighting: bright midday sun straight down the pit, warm key always on the goose's face, saturated clay orange, blue sky
motion_rule: camera always moving in sharp 0.3-0.8 s moves from frame one, each ending on the gag; the goose fills half the frame, except the close-up beats

audio.delivery: dry pompous elderly male goose, flat dry voice
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, last word by 6.5; after 6.5 no words, only sfx
audio.sfx: 0.3 confetti pop; 1.2 feet slap duckweed; 2.2 wings whoosh; 3.0 rubber boing, splash; 4.5 clay creak; 5.8 roots crunch; 7.0 seed crack; 7.5 handle scrape, falling whistle; 8.8 LOUDEST thud of earth, paper hat crunch; 9.6 blade bites soil

timeline.a: From the first frame, already deep in the pit: close-up, the goose flicks his paper cone with a wingtip, confetti rains on his party hat
timeline.c: plunges down, the mole's shovel handle in foreground

timeline.a: the goose struts round his tire, chest out, feet slapping duckweed; his cone drops into the duckweed; the mole leans back
the goose flaps his wings full width, rises half a meter, feathers and clods fly; the mole flinches from the feathers
timeline.c: rockets up, feathers past the lens

timeline.a: the goose drops rump-first onto his tire, it bounces, splash; he hisses at the tire, neck low
close-up: the goose stretches his neck up the wall to the mole's shovel handle on the rim, beak one inch short, beak open
timeline.c: swings overhead, dives at his beak

timeline.a: the goose hooks his neck over the mole's shovel handle and hauls up, feet scraping clay, beak free and talking; the mole leans in, stops chewing
timeline.c: from below, arcing round his neck

timeline.a: the goose's head pops over the rim nose to nose with the mole, he raises one wing; the mole puts his paw on his shovel handle
timeline.c: tumbles over the rim to ground

timeline.a: close-up: the mole's paw yanks his shovel out from under the goose's neck; the goose falls backwards into the pit, wings spread
timeline.c: hurls itself at the mole's paw

timeline.a: close-up: the mole shovels clod after clod down with his shovel; earth fills the pit up to the goose's neck, the last clod crushes his party hat sideways, clod in foreground
close-up: the mole stabs his shovel blade into the soil beside the pit, flings the first clod of a new pit; behind him the filled pit, only the goose's crushed party-hat tip sticks out of the earth
timeline.c: rockets out, whips to the blade

negative_prompt: subtitles, captions, watermark, text overlay, letters or numbers on objects, logos, humans, English speech, foreign accent, slow speech, speech after 6.5, static camera, locked-off shots, a flat medium shot, floating objects, duplicate props, second shovel, extra limbs, extra characters beyond those listed, character changing appearance mid-shot, blood, night
